EmailTemplate.subject: Qantas Customer Care - {{{Case.Case_Number__c}}}
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {{{Case.First_Name__c}}},
Thank you for contacting Qantas in relation to the cyber incident.
We're taking this incident extremely seriously. The system remains secure and additional security measures have been put in place to strengthen system monitoring and protect customer information as part of our response.
We appreciate the time you have taken to provide us with your feedback and are deeply sorry that this incident occurred.
For more information and latest updates, please visit www.qantas.com/au/en/support/information-for-customers-on-cyber-incident.html
Kind regards
Qantas Customer Care
